# UX Checklist: Árvores declaradas

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the UX requirements for the declared tree screen, the approval gallery and the one-time warning for old Pins and marks, after the prototype findings
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the levels of the tree (pool, system group, source, children, leaf) and what each one shows (name, value, emoji) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 Is the rule that makes the pools of the first level (one pool per run of sums or of products) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002c]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified how a term that joins two sources appears (one line, the second source as a child with its system)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002b]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified what the player sees for a source that belongs to another class, so that it is never shown as a zero line? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002a]
- [x] CHK005 Is the content of the ⓘ of each line (curve, branch checks, how the pools join) specified for the declared tree? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK006 Are the elements of each gallery card (the tree image, the number's name, the system, "Aprova", "Corrigir + nota") specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified where the gallery shows how many trees a change of recipe or rule changed, and grouped how? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, §FR-024b]
- [x] CHK008 Is the text and the place of the one-time warning about old Pins and marks specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified what the gallery shows for a number whose recipe the lock rejected or that has no recipe yet? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-024b]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is the value format of each line type defined for the declared tree, or explicitly inherited from the 009? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK011 Is the depth of the gallery image (open down to the leaves) stated clearly, together with the screen still starting closed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Is the order of the system groups inside a pool defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013a]
- [x] CHK013 Is the name of the line of a two-source term defined (the first source's game name)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002b]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Is "the system always appears as a child" (FR-014) consistent with hiding a system whose sources are all of other classes (FR-002a)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-002a]
- [x] CHK015 Is the "no extra line when the tree does not close" rule (FR-019) consistent with "each level closes with the parent" (FR-015) as the player sees it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK016 Is the second source of a two-source term (FR-002b) consistent with "every system appears as a child" (FR-014) when that second source is another system? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002b, §FR-014]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are the requirements for "Needs the live map" in the declared tree stated? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is it specified what happens on the screen while live values arrive and a source's value goes to 0 or ×1? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is it specified what the player sees in a number with no approved recipe? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK020 Are keyboard and screen reader requirements stated for the gallery buttons and the note field? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK021 Are the tree's accessibility requirements (the 009 treeview announcements) explicitly kept? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 Is a time limit stated for the gallery of one world to open? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
